Files and backups
Keep up-to-date copies of your books and important data outside Foliore. Sync also propagates changes and deletions and does not replace an independent backup. Before deleting data, changing devices, or uninstalling the app, check your copies. Recovery depends on the files and versions still available and may not be possible in every case. This notice does not exclude liability imposed by law or limit your rights.

One-time purchase
Foliore unlimited removes the catalog limit of 50 books. The unlock has no scheduled expiry or recurring charge. It does not include books, extra Google Drive storage, or AI service credits.

Compatibility and updates
Compatibility is stated on the Google Play app listing. The purchase is not a promise of indefinite maintenance, new features, or operation on every future Android version and every device. This does not exclude updates needed for conformity, guarantees, or remedies required by applicable law.

Account and restoration
The purchase is linked to the Google Play account used for payment and can be restored on compatible devices using that account. Reinstalling does not require repurchasing a valid entitlement. Pending purchases unlock only after confirmation. The unlock does not replace a library backup.

Your books
The free limit applies to adding new books. Existing books remain available for editing, export, and sync, including when a restore exceeds the limit. A refund or revocation may reinstate the limit for new additions without deleting the library.

Support and rights
Use Support in Settings for help with problems or purchases. Refunds may be requested through Google Play or Support under the applicable rules. These terms do not limit statutory withdrawal, warranty, repair, or refund rights.
